guideHeadline: Visual UI Design Standards for Low-Literacy Farmers:
guideGreenDesc: 🟢 Green: The crop is completely healthy; safe to continue cultivation.
guideRedDesc: 🔴 Red: Disease detected; recommended pesticide name & spray can count matching PHI days appear.
guideYellowDesc: 🟡 Yellow: Camera shake or blurry leaf; prompt to hold steady and retake.
guidePhiDesc: 🌾 Countdown Timer: 1 spray can decays every 24 hours. At 0, prominent Golden Checkmark appears for safe harvest.
guideGpsDesc: ⚡ Offline with GPS: Diagnostic records and GPS coordinates stored in Room DB, automatically uploaded when online.
statusIdle: Ready for leaf photo capture and offline diagnosis
blurryAlert: ⚠️ Camera shook during capture. Please hold device steady and scan again.
sampleTestTitle: Select a field leaf for inspection:
safeHarvestDesc: PHI waiting period has expired (0 cans remaining). Crop is clean and free of chemical residues.
canRepresentsDay: Each spray can represents 1 day of the Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI)
healthWarning: ⚠️ Health Warning: Do not harvest, consume, or sell crop before all spray cans disappear and the golden checkmark appears.
syncQueueDesc: Offline-First Room SQLite with auto-upload upon network restoration
savedGpsRecords: Locally stored diagnoses with GPS coordinates:
noRecordsYet: No records yet. Tap 'Scan Plant Now' to capture and store diagnosis.
waitingFirstScan: Waiting for first sorghum plant scan
waitingFirstScanDesc: Tap 'Scan Plant Now' to initiate the interactive assessment and treatment workflow.
footerTagline: Sorghum Crop Disease Diagnosis System • Offline-First Android Architecture
wideColorGreenDesc: Crop is completely healthy; no pests or fungal pathogens identified.
wideColorYellowDesc: Please inspect plant or retake image steadily to confirm diagnosis.
wideColorRedDesc: Plant disease detected requiring prompt treatment and safety interval calculation.
queryingDbPesticide: Querying local database for certified pesticide...
cansUnlockedNotice: Spray cans revealed based on calculated safety interval
cansLockedNotice: Spray cans locked until PHI calculation completes
diseaseAnthracnoseDesc: Circular to elliptical spots with gray centers and dark reddish borders on the leaf blade.
diseaseRustDesc: Prominent reddish-brown pustules on upper and lower leaf surfaces causing premature drying.
diseaseSmutDesc: Floral heads replaced by dark powdery fungal spore masses, destroying grain yield completely.
diseaseHealthyDesc: Vibrant green leaves free from any lesions, fungal spots, or pest damage.
